qpq_ui_kind_secret_clause = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		NOT = { scope:recipient.top_liege = scope:actor.top_liege }

		exists = scope:actor.house
		scope:recipient = {
			is_landed = yes
			OR = {
				any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
				any_close_family_member = {
					OR = {
						any_spouse = { house ?= scope:actor.house }
						betrothed.house ?= scope:actor.house
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_kind value = flag:secret_clause }
		qpq_ui_clear_choices_effect = yes
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_gold = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_gold_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_gold
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					always = yes
				}
				trigger_else = {
					always = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_gold }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_gold
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_gold
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_land = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_land_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_land
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					scope:recipient = { any_held_title = { tier = tier_county count >= 2 } }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					scope:actor = { any_held_title = { tier = tier_county count >= 2 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_land }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_land
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_land
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_office = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_office_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_office
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
					scope:actor = {
						OR = {
							liege ?= scope:recipient
							is_courtier_of = scope:recipient
						}
						NOT = { is_councillor_of = scope:recipient }
					}
				}
				trigger_else = {
					scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							liege ?= scope:actor
							is_courtier_of = scope:actor
						}
						NOT = { is_councillor_of = scope:actor }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_office }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_office
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_office
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

					scope:actor = { any_close_family_member = { is_married = no NOT = { exists = betrothed } is_alive = yes } }

	}

		if = {

							NOT = { secret_owner = scope:recipient }
							NOT = { is_known_by = scope:recipient }
						}
					}
				}

		}

				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_contract }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_contract
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_contract
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_succession = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_succession_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_succession
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					scope:actor = { is_child_of = scope:recipient } NOT = { scope:recipient.primary_heir ?= scope:actor }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					scope:recipient = { is_child_of = scope:actor } NOT = { scope:actor.primary_heir ?= scope:recipient }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_succession }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_succession
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_succession
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_clemency = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_clemency_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_clemency
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					OR = {
						scope:actor = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:recipient }
						scope:recipient = { any_prisoner = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor } }
						scope:recipient = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:actor modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
					}
				}
				trigger_else = {
					OR = {
						scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned_by = scope:actor }
						scope:actor = { any_prisoner = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient } }
						scope:actor = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = scope:recipient modifier = qpq_criminal_pact_opinion } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_clemency }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_clemency
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_clemency
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

qpq_ui_offer_arms = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_arms_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_arms
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					scope:recipient = { is_landed = yes }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					scope:actor = { is_landed = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_arms }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_arms
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_arms
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}

					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					scope:recipient = { any_character_artifact = { always = yes } }
				}
				trigger_else = {

				}

			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_artifact

qpq_ui_offer_church = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_church_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_church
			AND = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
					scope:recipient = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes } }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					scope:actor = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes faith = { qpq_faith_has_church_trigger = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_church }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_church
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_church

	}

qpq_ui_offer_charter = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { actor recipient }
	is_shown = {
		qpq_ui_kind_allows_offer_charter_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			has_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter
			AND = {
				var:qpq_ui_payer_tier <= 0
				var:qpq_ui_agent_tier <= 0
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter }
			remove_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter
		}
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_timing value = flag:up_front }
		qpq_ui_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}
